headline: Council passes ProspectUs fund law, sends $1M playground plan to committee

sentences.text: The Council passed Ordinance 260919, a city law.
It also considered spending up to $1,100,000.00 on audio and video upgrades at City Hall.
A plan to spend $1,000,000.00 on a new playground at Barry Road Park went to a committee for review first.
The audio and video upgrades could cost up to $2,100,000.00.
